text: The new module has nine unit assertions without a nonempty expected-behavior message, plus one assert_eq in its doctest. They check enum positions, normalized ID matching, expansion/URI formatting, a typed result and an invalid-value error class. Those checks are distinct from the two new JavaScript size assertions, which do provide should messages. The source finding does not claim Rust or doctest execution.
title: The extended-property Rust examples and unit assertions omit messages
